page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture is supported by 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options and a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the average tier for multi-core and memory operations. The multi-core stress-ng score of 13974.04 and Geekbench multi-core score of 7205.0 reflect stable parallel processing capabilities. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1310.38 and a single-threaded gzip compression rate of 22.76 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth remains consistent, with read-only large block transfers reaching 89.18 GB/sec and write operations at 46.34 GB/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g6.4xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. It is well-suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, static web serving with a demonstrated throughput of 11.32 GB/sec, database operations, and software compilation tasks.
